rows.text: An abandoned base near to your location is overrun with vermin. The situation is causing the locals some issues and they have put together a small reward to pay anyone who can enter the base and remove the problem. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a c; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a c higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) marked with a c you encounter gain +1 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 4 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 4th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission has been completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

A science laboratory near to your location has suffered an infestation that has caused its personnel to go crazy. The corporation running the lab has put together a small reward to pay anyone who can enter the base and remove the problem. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a t; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a t higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) marked with a t you encounter gain +1 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 6 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 6th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission has been completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

O2 An industrial plant that relies solely on android staff near to your location has suffered a major insurgence over working conditions. The owner has put together a small reward to pay anyone who can enter the base and remove the problem. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a s; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a s higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) marked with a s you encounter gain +1 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 7 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 7th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission has been completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

A insubstantial entity has lodged itself into the air vents at an off-world military base. The creature is excreting a hallucinogenic chemical, and the contaminated air has caused the personnel to go utterly mad. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a ≡ ; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a ≡ higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies you encounter (except the special ENEMY) must be marked with a t; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a t higher on the table, re-roll for another enemy. All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) you encounter gain +1 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 8 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 8th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed you destroy the entity and the mission is completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward. reward the captain will receive): (1) A- Armour (undamaged), (2) I - Implants, (3) K - Kit (If you generate a security pass, roll again), (4) N - Needed, (5) TA - Trappings A, (6) TB - Trappings B, (7) TC - Trappings C, (8) W - Weapons, (9) 1d100 credits, (10) 1d100 x 10 credits. 88 (GB) IM - Instant Missions D10 Details          During an Instant Mission when you roll on table E apply the captain's current star system's threat modifier.

Whilst performing a top secret mission a special agent has gone missing and needs rescuing. The corporation has marked the recovery of the agent as a high priority and has assigned the mission as urgent. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies you encounter gain +2 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 9 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 9th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY and when it has been killed the agent is recovered alive and well. The mission is then completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

O2 NV A corporation that diverted a starship to an alien vessel to recover some specimens for analysis, has now been forced to relaunch the mission as the original crew never survived. The corporation still wants those specimens whatever the cost. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, its name must begin with "Hive", if does not look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy with a name that begins with "Hive" higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +20 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies with names that begin with "Hive" you encounter gain +2 Dmg. All other enemies gain +1 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 10 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 10th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed you recover the specimens (some eggs) the corporation wants for analysis; this completes the mission successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

O2 NV The Arachne Program, was an experiment to engineer a biped super soldier that had the speed of the Arachne (A spider-like humanoid) but was independent from the hive minds. However, it all went wrong and now several facilities across the galaxy are overrun with the Arachne and they need eliminating. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, its name must begin with "Arachne", if it does not look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy with a name that begins with "Arachne" higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies you encounter must have a name beginning with "Arachne"; if it does not look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy with a name that begins with "Arachne" higher on the table, re-roll for another enemy. All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) you encounter gain +2 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 11 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 11th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission is completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

O2 NV A fierce group of terrorists are holding an area of space to ransom with constant attacks on strategic targets. Their base must be dealt with and the ring leader brought to justice; dead or alive! SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a t; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a t higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) marked with a t you encounter gain +2 Dmg. DETAILS: Explore until 12 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 12th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission has been completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward.

O2 NV The Cyborg have infiltrated a large facility and the owner is offering a reward to anyone who can take them out. SPECIAL ENEMY: Roll for the special ENEMY, it must be marked with a s; if it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a s higher on the table, re-roll for the special ENEMY. The special ENEMY gains +10 HP. SPECIAL RULES: All enemies you encounter must be marked with a s; if when rolling it is not, look higher up the table until you find one. If there isn't an enemy marked with a s higher up on the table, re-roll for another enemy. All enemies (including the Special ENEMY) you encounter gain +2 Dmg and +1 Def. DETAILS: Explore until 13 areas have been added to the map sheet. When the 13th area has been fully dealt with you encounter the special ENEMY. When it has been killed the mission has been completed successfully and you receive the [S] reward. reward the captain will receive): (1) A- Armour (undamaged), (2) I - Implants, (3) K - Kit (If you generate a security pass, roll again), (4) N - Needed, (5) TA - Trappings A, (6) TB - Trappings B, (7) TC - Trappings C, (8) W - Weapons, (9) 1d100 credits, (10) 1d100 x 10 credits.
